name: topple-party
description: Jackbox-style physics party game. PC hosts, phones are the controllers, Jenga towers decide who goes home.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @topple/host && npm run build -w @topple/controller && npm run build -w @topple/server
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist apps/*/dist-types apps/*/.vite packages/*/dist *.tsbuildinfo apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo
